headline: Austria's model matches the OECD and the BMF calculator to the cent for employees; the official calculator overcharges pensioners' April 2025 Sonderzahlung KV (6 % vs 5,1 %), § 33 Abs. 7 EStG's wording differs from how the BMF pays the Kindermehrbetrag, and that credit's partner condition is an all-or-nothing cliff worth up to 1 400 EUR for one euro of a partner's pay.
